description: Pesupanda price list (dry cleaning, laundry, ironing, carpets, courier). Prices in EUR incl. VAT, also for business clients. An item name ending with * refers to the list row that starts with * (hood or belt). query matches Estonian and English names and word stems; result has match (exact | approximate | none | all) and exact_count (the first exact_count items are exact matches). match none = nothing matched, the full list is returned – do not conclude a service is unavailable.
name: get_prices
